pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions on the flank exhibit irregular, sub-polygonal geometries with predominantly rounded vertices. Edges display a soft pixel gradient from dark brown to light cream. Spatial area of patches is greatest on the mid-to-upper flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented clusters towards the ventral area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous topological network with frequent tri-nodal junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform in the mid-flank region, maintaining high continuity with no observed structural breaks in the visible network.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette along the upper neck displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated edge. Individual hair tufts create a jagged 1D profile with distinct pixel-level variance against the background foliage.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of micro-spots or secondary isolated pigment clusters located within the wider light-colored corridors on the lower flank.
